culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fenix Intermediate LLC | Term Loan B - 11.84 % (SOFR + 6.50 %, 1.75 % Floor) | $ | 5,994,674 | $ | 6,029,967

rationale: FX02 flagged fair_value_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw SOI presents the affected fair value fields in dollar-denominated columns. Representative flagged position rows show Fair Value amounts under '$' columns, and the schedule total also marks total fair value with '$'. The source therefore supports USD denomination; the issue is the rule treating a noncanonical USD unit label as non-USD.
